pairs.target: mǐlā dìngxià qùchù nàtiān , xiān jiāng zuōfang lǐ zìjǐ de túzhǐ fēnchéng le liǎngluò .
pairs.english: On the day Mira settled her placement, she first divided her own workshop drawings into two stacks.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉定下去处那天，先将作坊里自己的图纸分成了两摞。

pairs.target: dàizǒu de zhuāngjìn yóubù tào , liúxià de tān zài sū yǐ miànqián , gòngyòng de shìyòng jìlù lìng chāo yífèn .
pairs.english: She packed those to take in an oilcloth sleeve, spread those to leave before Suyi, and made another copy of their shared trial records.
pairs.hanzi: 带走的装进油布套，留下的摊在苏苡面前，共用的试用记录另抄一份。

pairs.target: sū yǐ yìzhāng zhāng kàn guòqù , fāxiàn jiá zhe zìjǐ yuánxiān gǎicuò de jiù tú , biàn chōuchūlái , shuō zhè zhāng bié dài , huà chéng nàyàng , chūqù yào diū liǎnggè rén de liǎn .
pairs.english: Suyi examined each, removing an old drawing she had corrected wrongly: take that and both would be embarrassed.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡一张张看过去，发现夹着自己原先改错的旧图，便抽出来，说这张别带，画成那样，出去要丢两个人的脸。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō zìjǐ liú zhe kàn cuò zài nǎlǐ , yòu jiāng tú sāi le huíqù .
pairs.english: Mira said she kept it to see the mistake, and stuffed it back.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说自己留着看错在哪里，又将图塞了回去。

pairs.target: lái dài tā de shījiě jiào gǔ jì , bái jiē bìyè hòu zài qiáo zuò shè gān le qīnián .
pairs.english: Her graduate supervisor was Guji, seven years at the Bridgework Cooperative since White Steps.
pairs.hanzi: 来带她的师姐叫谷霁，白阶毕业后在桥作社干了七年。

pairs.target: tāmen qián jǐtiān zhēngdé zuì xiōng de , búshì mǐlā néng bunéng zuò zìjǐ de xiǎoyàng , érshì tā yǐwéi qù le nàlǐ , shījiě jiù huì tì tā ānpái yìzhěngtào rénshǒu .
pairs.english: Their fiercest argument wasn't about Mira's own prototypes, but her assumption that Guji would arrange a whole team for her.
pairs.hanzi: 她们前几天争得最凶的，不是米拉能不能做自己的小样，而是她以为去了那里，师姐就会替她安排一整套人手。

pairs.target: gǔ jì shuō qiáo zuò shè búshì gěi xuéshēng téngchūlái de zuōfang ; yuànyì jiē tā , shìyīnwèi yǎnqián de qiáolán , tàbù hé shuǐdào dōu quē kěn cóng liángchǐcùn zuòdào zhuāng hǎo de niánqīngrén .
pairs.english: Guji said the cooperative wasn't a workshop cleared for students; she took Mira because railings, steps and waterways needed young people willing to work from measuring through installation.
pairs.hanzi: 谷霁说桥作社不是给学生腾出来的作坊；愿意接她，是因为眼前的桥栏、踏步和水道都缺肯从量尺寸做到装好的年轻人。

pairs.target: zuìhòu tándìng , měizhōu yǒu gùdìng bàntiān néng jìxù zìjǐ de xiǎoyàng , yòng duōshǎo liào réng zhào zuōfang de bànfǎ jì , shìyòng jiéguǒ yóu tā hé sū yǐ gèzì shǔ míng .
pairs.english: They agreed on half a day each week for her prototypes, materials logged as at the workshop and trial results attributed to her and Suyi.
pairs.hanzi: 最后谈定，每周有固定半天能继续自己的小样，用多少料仍照作坊的办法记，试用结果由她和苏苡各自署明。

pairs.target: biéde rìzi gēnzhe shèlǐ de zhēn huó zǒu , ruò yào gǎidòng jìhuà , xiān tóng yìqǐ gànhuó de rén shuō .
pairs.english: Other days followed actual cooperative jobs; changes required talking to coworkers first.
pairs.hanzi: 别的日子跟着社里的真活走，若要改动计划，先同一起干活的人说。

pairs.target: mǐlā bìng bù quán mǎnyì , què háishì qiān le .
pairs.english: Mira wasn't entirely satisfied, but signed.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉并不全满意，却还是签了。

pairs.target: tā shuō xiǎng kànkàn , biérén de tú dàodǐ yǒu duōshǎo yě dé gǎichéng zhèyàng .
pairs.english: She wanted to see how much other people's drawings needed changing too.
pairs.hanzi: 她说想看看，别人的图到底有多少也得改成这样。

pairs.target: sū yǐ xiào tā , shuō bié gāng qù jiù bǎ rénjiā tú quán tiāo yíbiàn , zìjǐ de hái quē yígè biāojì .
pairs.english: Suyi laughed: don't criticize all their drawings on arrival; hers still lacked a mark.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡笑她，说别刚去就把人家图全挑一遍，自己的还缺一个标记。

pairs.target: liǎng rén jǐ zài tóng yìzhāng tái biān bǔ hǎo , shuí yě méi shuō cóngcǐ jiù bù chǎo le .
pairs.english: They squeezed together to add it, neither promising never to argue again.
pairs.hanzi: 两人挤在同一张台边补好，谁也没说从此就不吵了。

pairs.target: nà shì tǎ wéi dào suǒ lǐ bào dào qiánliǎngtiān .
pairs.english: It was two days before Tavi's office start.
pairs.hanzi: 那是塔维到所里报到前两天。

pairs.target: tā guòlái zhǎo mǐlā , tīng wán tā de qùchù , wèn qiáo zuò shè zài chénglǐ háishì wàimiàn .
pairs.english: Visiting Mira and hearing her destination, he asked whether the cooperative was in town or outside town.
pairs.hanzi: 他过来找米拉，听完她的去处，问桥作社在城里还是外面。

pairs.target: tā shuō xiān zài chéngwài de gōngchǎng , hòutou gēnzhe huàn qiáolán de duì zǒu , dìzhǐ xiě hǎo le , zhēn biàn dìfāng zàijì .
pairs.english: First the workshop outside town, she said, then railing-replacement crews; the address was written, changes would come by letter.
pairs.hanzi: 她说先在城外的工场，后头跟着换桥栏的队走，地址写好了，真变地方再寄。

pairs.target: yīwén bàngwǎn cái lái , shǒulǐ méi dài tú , fǎndǎo dàilái yìdié méi cái qí de zhǐ .
pairs.english: Iven arrived at dusk with no map, but unevenly cut paper.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文傍晚才来，手里没带图，反倒带来一叠没裁齐的纸。

pairs.target: tā dìng de shì tōnglù yìshì chù , gēn yíwèi jiào shī nán de bìyèshēng , zuò jiāojiē hé lái jiàn , guò jǐtiān háiyǒu liǎngchù xiànchǎng yào qù .
pairs.english: He had settled on the Route Council Office with a graduate named Shinan, handling handovers and incoming documents, with two field visits ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 他定的是通路议事处，跟一位叫施南的毕业生，做交接和来件，过几天还有两处现场要去。

pairs.target: fùqīn rènde nàbiān de rén , què búshì fùqīn tì tā tán hǎo de nà zhāng gēn gǎng yuē .
pairs.english: His father knew people there, but hadn't negotiated his placement.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲认得那边的人，却不是父亲替他谈好的那张跟岗约。

pairs.target: " tāmen xiān wèn wǒ néng bunéng bǎ biérén bú ài tīng de yuánhuà yě jìxiàlái . "
pairs.english: “They asked if I could record unwelcome exact words,”
pairs.hanzi: “他们先问我能不能把别人不爱听的原话也记下来。”

pairs.target: yīwén shuō , " wǒ shuō néng .
pairs.english: Iven said. “I said yes.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说，“我说能。

pairs.target: shī nán jiù wèn , nà nǐ zìjǐ shuō guò bùhǎo tīng dehuà ne . "
pairs.english: Shinan asked: what about your own unpleasant words?”
pairs.hanzi: 施南就问，那你自己说过不好听的话呢。”

pairs.target: dé mǎ xiào dé chàdiǎn cóng dèng shàng huáxiàqù , wèn tā zěnme dá .
pairs.english: Dema nearly slid off her bench laughing. His answer?
pairs.hanzi: 德玛笑得差点从凳上滑下去，问他怎么答。

pairs.target: tā shuō xiān dá néng , huílái yǐhòu cái xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ yǒu duō dà máfán .
pairs.english: He said his answer was yes first, then on returning realized how much trouble he was in.
pairs.hanzi: 他说先答能，回来以后才想起自己有多大麻烦。

pairs.target: pà wò de qùchù dǎo hái zài chénglǐ , gēn yígè cóng bái jiē chūlái , gěi xì péng zuò huódòng jià hé jīguān de shīfu , wǎnshàng kěyǐ huí sùshè .
pairs.english: Pavo's placement stayed in town, with a White Steps graduate making movable frames and mechanisms for theaters; he could return to the dormitory at night.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃的去处倒还在城里，跟一个从白阶出来、给戏棚做活动架和机关的师傅，晚上可以回宿舍。

pairs.target: tā xiān xuānbù zìjǐ búhuì tì suǒyǒu chūmén de rén bǎoguǎn zāng yīfu , yòu shuō zhēn yǒu jíshì , xìn kěyǐ xiěgěi tā , zìjǐ búhuì yīnwèi bù zǒu yuǎn jiù shǎo yígè míngzì .
pairs.english: He announced he wouldn't store everyone's dirty clothes, but urgent letters could come to him; staying nearby didn't make him less of a name on their list.
pairs.hanzi: 他先宣布自己不会替所有出门的人保管脏衣服，又说真有急事，信可以写给他，自己不会因为不走远就少一个名字。

pairs.target: zhè jù huà shuōwán , wūlǐ jìng le yìxiǎo xià .
pairs.english: The room briefly quieted.
pairs.hanzi: 这句话说完，屋里静了一小下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ yìzhāng kōng zhǐ tuī gěi tā , jiào tā yě xiě shōuxìn chù .
pairs.english: Tavi pushed him blank paper to write his address too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把一张空纸推给他，叫他也写收信处。

pairs.target: pà wò rènrènzhēnzhēn xiěxià sùshè mén hào , hái tiān yìháng , bié bǎ mántou jiá zài xìn lǐ .
pairs.english: Pavo carefully wrote the dormitory number, adding: don't enclose steamed buns in letters.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃认认真真写下宿舍门号，还添一行，别把馒头夹在信里。

pairs.target: tāmen bǎ jǐchù dìzhǐ chāo chéng xiāngtóng de jǐzhāng , méi huà chéng yìzhāng fǎngfú rénrén měitiān dōu néng xiāngyù de dìtú .
pairs.english: They copied matching address lists, not a map pretending everyone could meet daily.
pairs.hanzi: 他们把几处地址抄成相同的几张，没画成一张仿佛人人每天都能相遇的地图。

pairs.target: dé mǎ de cèhuì qùchù hái děng zuìhòu nàwèi dài rén de huílái , tā yě méi jí zhe bǎ zìjǐ sāijìn biérén yǐjīng dìng hǎo de lù , zhī shēnshǒu yào le yìzhāng , xiān tì dàjiā yāpíng zhǐ jiǎo .
pairs.english: Dema's survey placement still awaited the supervisor's return; she didn't rush onto someone else's road, just took a sheet and flattened its corners for them.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛的测绘去处还等最后那位带人的回来，她也没急着把自己塞进别人已经定好的路，只伸手要了一张，先替大家压平纸角。

pairs.target: wǎnshàng méiyǒu lìng bǎi yídùn sòngxíng fàn .
pairs.english: There was no separate farewell feast.
pairs.hanzi: 晚上没有另摆一顿送行饭。

pairs.target: yǒurén míngzǎo shàngkè , yǒurén yào qù lǐng gōngjù , zhuōshàng zhǐyǒu gèzì cóng shítáng dàihuí de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Some had classes, others tools to collect; the table held their dining-hall food.
pairs.hanzi: 有人明早上课，有人要去领工具，桌上只有各自从食堂带回的东西。

pairs.target: mǐlā bāikāi yíkuài bǐng , yīwén ná xiǎo dāoxiāo wāi zhǐbiān , sū yǐ xián tā yuè xiāo yuè xiǎo , bǎ dāo názǒu , zìjǐ lái .
pairs.english: Mira broke bread, Iven trimmed crooked paper edges, and Suyi took the knife when his sheets kept shrinking.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉掰开一块饼，伊文拿小刀削歪纸边，苏苡嫌他越削越小，把刀拿走，自己来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngdào sè lā yǐjīng kànguò hé lù suǒ de ānpái , zìjǐ de jǐjiàn yīfu yě bǔ hǎo le , hūrán juéde míngtiān búbì zài zhǎo yìzhuāng bìxū zuò wán cáinéng zǒu de shì .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered Sela had seen the office arrangements and his clothes were mended. Tomorrow needed no new task that had to be finished before leaving.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想到瑟拉已经看过合路所的安排，自己的几件衣服也补好了，忽然觉得明天不必再找一桩必须做完才能走的事。

pairs.target: tā bǎ yào hái de liáng gān kào zài ménbiān , bào dào nàtiān dài qù , zài búyòng cóngtóu wèn huì buhuì yǒurén kěn shōu .
pairs.english: He set the borrowed rod by the door for his reporting day, no longer wondering whether anyone would accept him.
pairs.hanzi: 他把要还的量杆靠在门边，报到那天带去，再不用从头问会不会有人肯收。

pairs.target: sànkāi qián , yīwén shuō dìyīhuí fǎnxiào fùchá dàyuē zài sìzhōu hòu , ruò rìzi cuòkāi , jiù gěi pà wò liúhuà , shuíyǒukōng shuí xiān chī , bùxǔ zài děngdào miàn tuó chéng yìtuán .
pairs.english: Before parting, Iven mentioned the first school review in roughly four weeks; if dates differed, leave Pavo word and let everyone eat when free, without waiting for noodles to clump.
pairs.hanzi: 散开前，伊文说第一回返校复查大约在四周后，若日子错开，就给帕沃留话，谁有空谁先吃，不许再等到面坨成一团。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō kěyǐ , dàn tā qiàn de yídùn bàn , réng bùnéng suàn chéng dàjiā yì rén yìkǒu .
pairs.english: Mira agreed, but her owed meal and a half couldn't become one mouthful each for everyone.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说可以，但她欠的一顿半，仍不能算成大家一人一口。

pairs.target: pà wò shuō nà shì tā tīng guò zuìxiǎo qì de sòngháng huà .
pairs.english: Pavo called it the stingiest farewell he had heard.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃说那是他听过最小气的送行话。

pairs.target: mǐlā huíjìng , zhèlǐ yòu méi rén sǐ bié , shǎo bǎi nà fù liǎn .
pairs.english: Mira retorted nobody was dying; stop making that face.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉回敬，这里又没人死别，少摆那副脸。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了。

pairs.target: chūménshí , tā méiyǒu huítóu bǎ zhè jiān wūzi jìde xiàng yǐhòu zàiyě jiàn búdào .
pairs.english: Leaving, he didn't turn to memorize the room as though he'd never see it again.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时，他没有回头把这间屋子记得像以后再也见不到。

pairs.target: tā zhī tì zuìhòu chūlái de sū yǐ fúzhù mén , děng tā jiāng túzhǐ bào wěn , cái yíkuàiér zǒu xiàtáijiē .
pairs.english: He held the door for Suyi, last out, waiting until her drawings were secure before they went down the steps together.
pairs.hanzi: 他只替最后出来的苏苡扶住门，等她将图纸抱稳，才一块儿走下台阶。
